thread:
Maria: heads-up — dashboard spike on Quota Visor (QA) for tenant org-42, looks like duplicate credit counts after the ingest-api rollout.
Ashok: ugh, saw that. Is this the shadowing we enabled for the new route-resolver? :thinking_face:
Maria: yes, we flipped shadow=true for a week. counts doubled in the preview but should be filtered before invoicing.
Kevin: where are we deduping today? edge proxy or the aggregator? last I checked dedupe was in tally-service post-agg.
Ashok: dedupe currently lives in tally-service, keyed by routing_fingerprint + hour. Shadow events are tagged with tag=visor-shadow so they should be ignored by invoice path.
Samira: but the console preview queries the preview/ingest index which includes shadow events. that's why the Quota Visor card shows doubled usage.
Maria: exactly — UX is alarming PMs. We need a short-term fix to avoid confusing customers while we keep shadowing on.
Kevin: quick option: add a preview filter on console backend to exclude tag=visor-shadow. trivial in the UI service.
Ashok: agree, but long-term we also need telemetry that proves shadow hits don't reach billing pipeline. otherwise a broken filter could leak to invoices.
Samira: can we add a computed metric 'ingest.events.count{shadow=true}' and 'ingest.events.count{shadow=false}' in prometheus? would make rollouts safer.
Maria: +1. Also add a dashboard card that shows billing-path events vs preview-path events for a tenant.
Kevin: code-wise: UI fix first — PR + canary. I'll open a branch now and add the tag filter to the preview query.
Ashok: also, can we add a guard in tally-service that will reject events with tag=visor-shadow if invoice_flag=true? defensive programming.
Samira: yes please. that prevents accidental leak-through. but we should be careful about historical backfills.
Maria: good point — backfills will replay and might carry the tag. we should ensure backfill pipeline strips shadow tag or sets invoice_flag=false.
Kevin: I'll add a small migration: backfill job sets invoice_flag=false where tag=visor-shadow. low-risk.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: ui/console-filter branch -> canary(10%), user:Kevin
Maria: once canary is up, someone verify Quota Visor card for org-42 goes back to baseline.
Samira: I'll watch the dashboard and set an alert if preview/billing ratio >1.1 for 5m.
Ashok: ops checklist: (1) UI filter canary, (2) tally-service guard PR, (3) backfill strip, (4) add prometheus metrics + dashboard. order: 1,2,4,3? any objections?
Kevin: prefer 1,2,4,3 too. backfill last to avoid surprises during rollout.
Maria: agreed. Kevin — ping here when deploy finishes. Samira — can you draft the dashboard card and alert thresholds? put screenshots in the PR.
Samira: on it. will include example queries and a note about invoice exposure risk.
Kevin: deploy-bot: canary success -> promoted to 100% (deployment-id: d-9832)
deploy-bot: monitor: ui/console-filter - no errors in 10m
Maria: verified org-42 Quota Visor now matches billing path, thanks.
Ashok: I've started the tally-service guard PR, small change: drop events where tag=visor-shadow and invoice_flag=true. test added.
Samira: dashboard draft is here: https://dashboards.internal/QuotaVisor/shadow-vs-billing — added panels and alert rules.
Maria: nice. last note: let's document the shadowing contract in eng-platform runbook so future rollouts don't surprise PMs.
Kevin: will add runbook section to the PR.
Maria: OK closing this thread after we merge the three PRs and run the backfill in a maintenance window. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
